@suzanne just here to complain, just came across a video of some spiritual leader guru or whatever they are, some female was telling him en asking stuff, basic spiritual stuff, spirituality of normal people or porpular one you find everywhere which is fancy words that are empty or barely have substance. the guy was refusing to answer some stuff sure i figure what he refused is something u can get on google, think it was conciusness en awakening, he kept saying accept it, awakening is just a change accept it ( aka dont question it), mentioning change in frequency, the new you, memory loss is normal, memory is just something that dont exist, if you have to know something you just do, i was Flabbergasted, ontop the whole session of question asnswer took less than 2 minutes or slighly more, he was so sure en certain in his answers i mean even i leave chance of doubt then again i have learn long to accept conflict beliefs as true en unchanging while always ready to discard or change them when i observe they are being useless or have turned to be obstacles en holdbacks. the whole session gave me impression of fast food spirituality with intention to serve as many en move more, it felt like talking for sake of it, not tranmition of information en experience to shape en enlighten the listner to be motivated to go seek their truth en never follow u as what u saying is ur experince not their, sure mostly i plant seed in my words which one can argue that it goes againt my expectation in saying my words are to be used as motivation never a guide en each should find their path, setting seeds dont go against that if anything they serve as future land mark pole to guid u en knowing my words are nothing more than motivation or loose guide at worse the seed should never hold you hostage but be light house u can ignore or move towards when lost, ( its better than spending months and weeks en years daily constantly pondering something to better ur understanding like i tend to, after all i would rather shortcut sometimes, after al not all walked path contains lesson worth knowing).

This got me thinking that this self given title of spiritual-teacher-temporary should be excersized so i can throw it away, it meant to remind me of what to do, which has been for years now telling myself i should do, but i have slowly been moving to reveal my experinces sure the way is crude but im not here to baby anyone, so i dont care, so long even one person could make sense of what i say en be motivated in this whole world, universe or existance then ill take the text to be no wasted efford on my part, after all i rather be pondering spiritual things all day long than be borded to guide anyone or anything, en be annoyed by people inherited beliefs en ideals after all my spiritual path is not of peace but build on defying fate, gods, existance even defying me myself if i realise im going against my expectations on me or beliefs.

Sigh i really, have to get ride of the self given title by doing its meaning for a while, but im kinda busy, im literally trying to takeover spirit world like literally but im failing by one stupid thing, i say stupid buy the weakness which is also strengh has been there with me from day one since is could enter spirit world over decade en half years ago only almost a year now have i had to face it than avoid it like i had for very long since it was not obstacle then much but now is. for those who wanna know issue is simple, all i have to do is keep memory en awarness of that im in spirit world en not on earth, not i do get it once in a month or few but thats not enough it time waste, it should be there everyday not spontaniusly else thinking im still in this physically body kinda hold me back en this is fudermentally the true issue holding everyone who ever lived or walked physical world long enough to forget they are more than incapable physical body, this problem is small but over a decade i still strugling to deal with even more so now that is one main remaining obstacle from my final goals i have been setting since i started spiritual seeking.  

by way attemptimg to live towards my title check out on github by tsehla [ primordial-chaos-spiritual-path ] search for it, spirituality is not easy but not impossible, its even easier if you have experinces of someone to be motivated by not to follow or expect youd get same, but result sould be very similar suzanne has proven the her from year and half now i recognise here more than one before to be similar to how i was have been
